name: Front Plank

instructions.description: Place forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders.
Extend the legs or keep the knees down for support.
Maintain a comfortable straight line through the trunk while breathing.
End the hold before the hips sag or the shoulders become uncomfortable.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.

commentsNotes: Use an elevated surface or knees-down position to reduce difficulty.

Keep your core actively engaged throughout the entire hold., Avoid letting your hips sag, as this can place unnecessary strain on your lower back. Avoid raising your hips too high into a position similar to Downward Dog. Think about keeping your body as one straight, strong line.

variations.variationDescription: Front Plank — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Front Plank — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
